_doc: PROPOSED integration overrides for the knowledge-redesign package (design data only; nothing here is runtime content and nothing is ratified).

Written by the integration adjudicator; read by tools/integrate.py after the lane part files are merged. Each override applies one adjudicated cross-lane request (research/integration-adjudication.md has one row per request, with the decision and its reason).

Why overrides exist: a lane part file may name only EXISTING ids from other lanes, so an edge onto another lane's NEW id, an agreed edit to another lane's record, or a reverse-index grant from another lane's contract can only be written here.

Cost discipline: no factor is re-scored for pacing. Where a prerequisite change alters the number of top-level AND conjuncts (an OR group counts once), factors.prereq_complexity follows the convention (1 -> 0.0, 2 -> 0.5, >=3 -> 1.0; ledger :425-426, D-047 :467-470, digest C-10/C-26) and the reason states the cost move. The one content re-score (printing_press material) is the workload-conserving carve-out both owning lanes agreed.

Labels: PROPOSED (all overrides) / MEASURED (costs computed by tools/integrate.py; chronology and Eureka checks by tools/validate.py V21/V22) / INFERENCE (historical judgement not re-verified here) / OPEN DECISION (Director-level; listed in the adjudication log).

set.prereqRationale: chemistry_quantitative: the refrigerant chemistry (ammonia, ether, sulphur dioxide). steam_rotary: the rotary steam power and compressor machinery that drove the plant. thermodynamics (D04 new id, added at integration): Linde designed his 1876 ammonia compression machine from thermodynamic efficiency, doubling the existing efficiency benchmark (D04 and D01, RESEARCHED in their notes). Chronology: thermodynamics' earliest marked year 1824 CE precedes refrigeration's 1876 CE; both A8.

overrides.reason: OV-01. Third top-level requirement (thermodynamics): prereq_complexity 0.5 -> 1.0 by the convention, magnitude 8.0 -> 8.5, cost 23,650 -> 33,450 RP. No other factor touched.

set.prereqRationale: gas_engine: the four-stroke compression cycle Diesel's engine uses (Diesel worked from the stationary-engine tradition at MAN). open_hearth: steel for the high-pressure cylinder and crank. internal_combustion (now the high-speed petrol engine) is not part of the diesel lineage. thermodynamics (D04 new id, added at integration): Diesel's 1893 treatise designed an engine to approach the Carnot cycle (RESEARCHED by D04/D06). Chronology: 1824 CE precedes 1897 CE.

overrides.reason: OV-02. Third top-level requirement (thermodynamics): prereq_complexity 0.5 -> 1.0 by the convention, magnitude 8.5 -> 9.0, cost 33,450 -> 47,310 RP (C-26). Override text is D06's integrationRequests entry; D06 labelled it 'rebalance', the integrator labels a convention-only cost move 'rewire' (framework section 4).
overrides.source: D04 request to D06 (D04-06), accepted by D06 (D06-02); D06 integrationRequests.overrides[0]

set.prereqRationale: steam_high_pressure: the high-pressure steam the turbine expands. open_hearth: steel for discs and blading. thermodynamics (D04 new id, added at integration): multi-stage turbines are designed from the thermodynamics of steam expansion (Rankine 1859; Parsons 1884). Chronology: 1824 CE precedes 1884 CE.

set.prereqRationale: Two independent hardware routes (OR, independent inventions): valve switching (Colossus, ENIAC) or relay switching from telephone-exchange engineering (Zuse's Z3 and Stibitz's Bell Labs calculator were built from telephone relays). At integration the relay route names its own knowledge, automatic_switching (D05 new id: Strowger 1891, first automatic exchange 1892), instead of the telephone proxy. calculus: the numerical mathematics these machines automated. punched_card_tabulation is deliberately NOT required: it requires jacquard, which would make computer's append-only Eureka (when: jacquard) implied - the loader refuses that (ResearchContent.cs:649-682; validator V22).

overrides.reason: OV-05. Member swap inside the OR group: one OR group counts once, so prereq_complexity 0.5 and cost 267,620 RP are unchanged. The OR members are not must-hold atoms, so the chronology test is unaffected.
overrides.source: D05 request to D06 (D05-01), accepted by D06 (D06-03); D06 integrationRequests.overrides[3]

set.prereqRationale: electromagnetic_field_theory (D04 new id, replaces electromagnetism, which it implies): Marconi's wireless (1895) used the waves Maxwell predicted (1865) and Hertz produced (1887-88); the experimental laws of electromagnetism alone do not give radio. telegraph: Morse signalling practice and the telegraph industry that wireless telegraphy extended. Chronology: 1865 CE precedes 1895 CE; both A8.

overrides.reason: OV-06. Substitution: two top-level requirements before and after, so prereq_complexity 0.5 and cost 66,900 RP are unchanged; the a9_radio supporting-fact closure gains electromagnetic_field_theory (23,650 RP).

Chronology: 1865 CE precedes 1938 CE.

overrides.reason: OV-07. Substitution: two top-level requirements before and after, so prereq_complexity 0.5 and cost 23,650 RP are unchanged.

set.prereqRationale: orbital_launch_vehicle (D08 new id, replaces rocket, which it implies): after D08's split, 'rocket' keeps the liquid-fuel rocket ENGINE (1926/1944) and orbit is reached by the staged, guided vehicle (R-7, 1957), the causal prerequisite of Sputnik; without the re-point a satellite would be reachable from the bare engine. computer and transistor: tracking and long-life transistorised payloads (Explorer 1 onward). D05 consented to the satellite requiring the ORBITAL vehicle (its reply assumed the orbital part would keep the 'rocket' id; D08's final split kept the engine there instead). Chronology: 1957 CE equals 1957 CE (not later).

overrides.reason: OV-08. Substitution: three top-level requirements before and after, so prereq_complexity 1.0 and cost 378,470 RP are unchanged; satellite's closure gains orbital_launch_vehicle (189,240 RP) - net change on space paths -189,250 RP against the unsplit rocket (D08).

Chronology: cupellation ~3,600 BCE precedes hacksilver ~2,000 BCE; both A3, both trunk.

overrides.reason: OV-09. Substitution: two top-level requirements before and after, so prereq_complexity 0.5 and cost 2,960 RP are unchanged. MEASURED effect: the a5_coinage CORE closure gains cupellation (2,090 RP); it is a causal addition, not a re-pricing.

set.prereqRationale: ore_prospecting (D11 new id, A3 trunk) replaces copper_smelting, which it requires and therefore still guarantees: tin bronze needs the smelting of copper AND the recognition of cassiterite (stream-tin placers and lode outcrops) as tin ore - tin sources were the Bronze Age bottleneck, and the D11 identification contract names ore_prospecting as the exposed tin-ore identification. The explicit 'copper_smelting AND ore_prospecting' form D02 had offered would be a redundant conjunct (copper_smelting is implied) that raises prereq_complexity without adding knowledge. Chronology: tin_bronze's earliest marked year (~4,650 BCE) lies before 3000 BCE, so the test does not check it; ore_prospecting (~5,000 BCE) is earlier in any case.

overrides.reason: OV-10. One top-level requirement before and after: prereq_complexity 0.0 and cost 7,030 RP unchanged (D02's form would have cost 9,950 RP). MEASURED effect: the tin route of the a3_bronze CORE fact gains ore_prospecting (1,240 RP); the arsenical route is unchanged. tin_bronze's Eureka (stock_tin_ore > 0) is a stock condition and unaffected.
overrides.source: D02 request to D11 (D02-01a) answered by D11 (D11-01a); the two proposed forms conflicted - settled for D11's non-redundant form

The fibre OR group gains cotton_cultivation (D01 new id): cotton was domesticated independently (Mehrgarh ~5,500 BCE; coastal Peru ~4,000 BCE) and spun on drop spindles - a third, genuinely independent fibre route, not a cost softener.

overrides.reason: OV-11. OR-group widening: one OR group counts once, so prereq_complexity 0.5 and cost 620 RP are unchanged. cotton_cultivation is A2 like spinning_spindle and trunk; OR members are not must-hold atoms.

set.prereqRationale: type_founding (key 216, which D07 re-points to casting_closed and relocates to the trunk) replaces casting_closed, which it implies: type casting in Gutenberg's adjustable hand mould and type metal (~1,440-1,450 CE, Strasbourg and Mainz) is the causal precondition of the press, not its sequel. mechanics_archimedean: the screw press adapted from wine, oil and paper presses. paper: the printing substrate. Chronology: type_founding's 1,440 CE precedes the press's 1,450 CE; both A7 trunk (the V17 exception both lanes requested).

overrides.reason: OV-13. Substitution keeps three top-level requirements (prereq_complexity 1.0). The press's Eureka (olive_press_beam) is not implied by type_founding (V22).

set.prereqRationale: Darwin's and Wallace's theory explained the natural system of classification (Origin, ch. 13: taxonomy) and drew on artificial selection (Origin, ch. 1: selective_breeding). stratigraphy (D11 new id, added at integration): deep geological time and the fossil succession (Smith 1815; Lyell 1830-33, read by Darwin on the Beagle) are knowledge natural selection needs. Chronology: stratigraphy 1669 CE precedes evolution 1858 CE; both A8 natural_science. The Eureka (carrack OR caravel) stays a circumstance: neither ship is guaranteed by the new prerequisite (V22).

overrides.reason: OV-14. Third top-level requirement: prereq_complexity 0.5 -> 1.0 by the convention, magnitude 8.0 -> 8.5, cost 23,650 -> 33,450 RP (+41 %; 16,730 RP at HEAD). The convention is applied as ratified; whether deepening should re-price hubs this way is D04's open question 1, raised as an OPEN DECISION.

set.prereq: electromagnetic_field_theory AND thermodynamics AND spectroscopy AND periodic_system AND radioactivity
set.prereqRationale: Planck's quantum (1900) answered the black-body problem - electromagnetic radiation in thermal equilibrium, i.e. field theory plus thermodynamics and Boltzmann's statistical entropy; Bohr (1913) and Heisenberg (1925) worked from spectral lines (spectroscopy); Pauli's exclusion principle (1925) explained the closing of electron groups behind the periodic system. radioactivity (D11 new id, added at integration as the atomic-structure input D04 asked for): radioactive transformation showed the atom has internal structure, and the 1911 nuclear atom on which Bohr built was revealed by alpha-particle scattering from radioactive sources. No cycle: nuclear_physics stays after quantum_mechanics. Chronology: radioactivity 1896 CE precedes 1925 CE; both A9 natural_science.

overrides.reason: OV-15. Fifth top-level requirement: prereq_complexity is already 1.0 (>= 3 conjuncts), so cost 133,810 RP is unchanged; the closure gains radioactivity (79,560 RP). The optional spectroscopy/periodic_system inputs to radioactivity were declined by D11 (its observation was photographic).
overrides.source: D04 request to D11 (D04-13), offered by D11 (D11-02 item 1); D04's prereqRationale pre-authorised it

set.prereqRationale: medicine_hippocratic: disease categories and the Hippocratic observation of environment and illness. probability_statistics (D04 new id, added at integration) replaces hindu_arabic: Graunt (1662), Farr and Snow (1854) compared rates statistically, and the probability-and-statistics node (Pascal and Fermat 1654 onward) carries that method. Positional arithmetic stays guaranteed through probability_statistics -> algebra -> (hindu_arabic OR counting_rods), so the counting-rod alternative D03 and D10 agreed on is honoured without a separate OR group. Death registration is a civic input (census), not a technology prerequisite. Chronology: 1654 CE precedes 1662 CE; A7 <= A8.

overrides.reason: OV-16. Substitution: two top-level requirements before and after, so prereq_complexity 0.5 and cost 11,830 RP are unchanged. Keeping hindu_arabic (or the OR) beside probability_statistics would be a redundant conjunct (+41 % by the convention) - declined for that reason.
overrides.source: D04 request to D10 (D04-11), requested by D10 itself (D10-03 item 2); also settles D03-08 and D10-05 (counting_rods OR)

set.prereqRationale: census: regular tables need recurring counts. Positional arithmetic for the tabulation: hindu_arabic or (added at integration) counting_rods - Chinese state population and land registers (decennial Ming Yellow Registers from 1381 CE; earlier Han and Tang household counts) were compiled with rod and abacus arithmetic, a genuinely independent tradition of official statistics (INFERENCE from general history; the corpus stage should verify and date it). D03 offered the OR; D12 (owner) wrote its part before the offer and did not answer.

overrides.reason: OV-17. OR-group widening: one OR group counts once, so the requirement count stays two (prereq_complexity 0.5) and cost 5,910 RP is unchanged; counting_rods is A5 trunk, official_statistics A7. OR members are not must-hold atoms, so the chronology test is unaffected.
overrides.source: D03 offer to D12 (D03-07 item d); owner silent; decided at integration

set.prereq: internal_combustion AND basic_process AND rifled_artillery AND machine_gun AND mechanised_agriculture
set.prereqRationale: internal_combustion: the engine. basic_process: cheap mass steel for armour plate. rifled_artillery: its quick-firing breech-loading guns. machine_gun: its secondary (or, on 'female' tanks, only) armament and the weapon it was built to defeat. mechanised_agriculture (added at integration, both lanes agreeing): the track-laying vehicle - Holt's track-type agricultural tractors (1904) inspired the British and French tanks (D09, RESEARCHED). Chronology: D01 re-dated mechanised_agriculture to 1892 CE (earliest), which precedes 1916 CE; both A9 (agriculture -> military, subtree to subtree).

overrides.reason: OV-18. Fifth top-level requirement: prereq_complexity is already 1.0, so cost 23,650 RP is unchanged; the closure gains mechanised_agriculture and its farm-machinery ancestors.
overrides.source: D09 request to D01 (D09-04), met by D01's re-dating (D01-05: 'D09 or the integrator adds it to tank'); applied here

set.prereqRationale: light_water_reactor (D11's re-point, kept): Nautilus' plant was a compact pressurised-water reactor from the naval programme that also led Shippingport [NUC-71, NUC-69]. submarine (D08 new id, replaces screw_propeller, which it implies): Nautilus (1954) was a nuclear plant in a submarine design - ballast, trim, pressure hull and submerged handling are the knowledge the conventional submarine (USS Holland, 1900) supplies; the screw propeller stays in the closure through it. Chronology: nuclear_submarine's emerged text ('1954') carries no era marker; submarine (1900 CE) is earlier in any case.

overrides.reason: OV-19. Substitution: two top-level requirements before and after, so prereq_complexity 0.5 and cost 133,810 RP are unchanged. Whether unit.nuclear_submarine falls under the Spine's nuclear rescoping is D11's OPEN DECISION 3.
overrides.source: D08 request to D11 (D08-03); D11's own re-point of the reactor half retained

set.prereq: cuneiform OR hieroglyphic OR chinese_script OR mesoamerican_script
set.prereqRationale: Measuring fields and recording their boundaries and areas needs a written numeration; any full writing tradition carries one. The ratified Group-B generic-writing set (cuneiform, hieroglyphic, chinese_script) gains mesoamerican_script (D05 new id, added at integration as D03 offered): Aztec-period land documents record field measurements and areas in Mesoamerican writing and units (INFERENCE from general history; corpus stage to verify). RESEARCHED by D03: Fara area tables ~2,600-2,500 BCE. Every holder of arithmetic_babylonian already holds cuneiform.

overrides.reason: OV-20. OR-group widening: still one top-level OR group (prereq_complexity 0.0), cost 2,490 RP unchanged; mesoamerican_script is A3 trunk like surveying. Side effect flagged: under the current AI policy every OR member on a goal path joins the goal's union closure (D03 open question 1, OPEN DECISION).
overrides.source: D03 offer (D03-05 item a), D05 request to apply it (D05-07)

set.prereqRationale: calendar_lunar: systematic month counting. A written civil year needs a script; the generic-writing OR group gains mesoamerican_script (D05 new id, as D03 offered): the Mesoamerican 365-day haab' is an independent civil solar calendar recorded in Mesoamerican writing.

overrides.reason: OV-22. OR-group widening: two top-level requirements before and after (prereq_complexity 0.5), cost 1,760 RP unchanged; A3 trunk.

set.prereq: arithmetic_babylonian OR ((hieroglyphic OR chinese_script OR mesoamerican_script) AND calendar_lunar)
set.prereqRationale: Two routes to systematic astronomical records: Babylonian arithmetic astronomy, or a non-Babylonian script with lunar-calendar observation. The non-Babylonian route gains mesoamerican_script (D05 new id, as D03 offered): the Maya Venus and eclipse tables (Dresden Codex) are an independent tradition of recorded astronomy.

overrides.reason: OV-23. Member added inside an OR group: still one top-level OR (prereq_complexity 0.0), cost 1,760 RP unchanged; mesoamerican_script A3 <= astronomy_records A4.

entityChanges.reason: EC-14 (G-14). Vital statistics grew from mortality-table analysis (Graunt 1662, Halley 1693) and civil registration (Farr), not from calculus. Conflict settled here: D10/D12 proposed 'official_statistics AND epidemiology', D04 (open question 4) 'census AND probability_statistics'. The D10/D12 form is chosen because it subsumes D04's concern: epidemiology now requires probability_statistics (OV-16) and official_statistics requires census, so probability and the count both stay in the closure, and the registration office is named. D12's calculus fallback is not needed (epidemiology is in the package).
entityChanges.unlockListEdits: census and calculus drop inst.statistics_vital; official_statistics (already listing it) and epidemiology list it.
entityChanges.compatibility: Holders of census and calculus without official_statistics and epidemiology lose eligibility (no alias seam). Unrealized institution. The requirement now passes through a medicine-subtree node (eligibility after the research stage, as calculus already implied).
entityChanges.status: PROPOSED by D12 with D10; form chosen at integration over D04's; apply only if the Director rules OD-05 - OPEN DECISION

entityChanges.reason: EC-17 (D07's entity change, restated with the integration decision). Conflict settled for D07's engineering-only form: eligibility reads the knowledge needed to build, and sewerage and filtration (Chelsea 1829, Hamburg 1843, London 1859-1875) were built with brick, Portland cement and steam pumps under miasma theory, before germ theory and before reinforced concrete. D10's alternative 'sanitary_engineering AND (germ_theory OR epidemiology)' is declined at integration: it would gate a building on a public-health theory, which is adoption (D12's public_health_board, M8) and valuation (M9), not eligibility. Germ-theory water treatment (chlorination 1908) stays available to a later water-treatment node.
entityChanges.unlockListEdits: germ_theory and reinforced_concrete drop infra.sewerage_system; sanitary_engineering lists it.
entityChanges.compatibility: Holders of germ_theory AND reinforced_concrete lose eligibility until they research sanitary_engineering (unrealized entity: no gameplay effect today).
